_meta.description: Shared index settings. One primary shard because the rollover size is the shard size: max_primary_shard_size is per primary, so two primaries double the index. total_fields.limit is set with headroom over the composed count that `logsearch lint` reports. depth.limit is nested like its siblings: the index setting is index.mapping.depth.limit, and depth_limit with an underscore is the flattened FIELD parameter, which is a different thing in a different place. Elasticsearch rejects the whole template for the wrong one.
